intro.subtitle1: Hi, I’m Ivan Sion, a full-stack web developer based in Milan.
intro.subtitle2: I enjoy building user-friendly applications with clean, maintainable code and thoughtful UI design.
intro.subtitle3: I’m looking for opportunities to contribute to meaningful products while continuing to grow as a developer.

description.proj1: A web application that simplifies employee shift scheduling. Managers and admins can create and assign shifts efficiently, while employees can easily view their schedules.
description.proj2: An e-commerce website for bicycles, built as a training project during my course at Betacom Srl. It was my first experience with Angular and helped me develop a strong foundation in ASP.NET Core.
description.proj3: Music Player is my first single-page application, developed with guidance from senior developers at Selexi Srl. Inspired by Spotify, it helped me build a foundation in full-stack development while focusing on user experience and clean, well-structured code.
description.proj4: SplitFive is an Android expense-splitting application developed as a final group project during my one-year course at ITS Angelo Rizzoli. Working outside my usual skill set taught me to adapt to client requirements, meet deadlines, and collaborate effectively within a team.
